dedupe_keys.name: supplementary data for deep learning for industrial processes forecasting amine emissions from a carbon capture plant

description: A research consortium publishes raw measurement workbooks and fitted forecasting artefacts for amine emissions from an industrial carbon-capture plant. Zenodo supplies ten daily raw Excel files, transformed data objects, scalers and neural-network checkpoints under CC BY 4.0. The description gives a Python loading example for a temporal convolutional model and identifies the separate pyprocessta code repository. These measurements can calibrate emissions and process-control components in carbon-capture simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this plant process release. Coverage is the selected measurement days and plant configuration; the public summary does not state a full sampling interval, location or sensor quality screen. A limitation is that model checkpoints depend on compatible code and exact preprocessing; an opaque checkpoint alone does not prove predictive transfer. The raw data and checkpoint files were not downloaded, and neither the emissions measurements nor forecast skill was reproduced.
